crossRefs.note: The fish that are in the river will die and the river will become foul. The Egyptians will loathe to drink water from…
and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.

parallels.note: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Nile
people.line: The major river of Egypt, mentioned in various contexts

translations.web: The fish that were in the river died. The river became foul. The Egyptians couldn’t drink water from the river. The blood was throughout all the land of Egypt.
translations.bsb: The fish in the Nile died, and the river smelled so bad that the Egyptians could not drink its water. And there was blood throughout the land of Egypt.
translations.kjv: And the fish that was in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.
translations.asv: And the fish that were in the river died; and the river became foul, and the Egyptians could not drink water from the river; and the blood was throughout all the land of Egypt.
